q: Which variety made the most runners?
Calculate the total new plants for Honeoye.
Explain why farmers grow new strawberry plants from runners, not seeds.
Runners are clones: every new plant has the same genes, so the same large, tasty fruit. Seeds give variation.
A disease kills Elsanta plants. Evaluate the risk of growing only Elsanta from runners.
All the plants are genetically identical, so if one is not resistant, none are: the whole crop could be lost. Growing several varieties spreads the risk.
